Primary Purpose: Scrub decking boards and stair treads from standing height
Safety / Compatibility: Stiff enough for algae film, soft enough not to raise the grain on softwood. Work with the grain of the boards.

Primary Purpose: Clean outdoor cushion and canopy fabric without stripping its water resistance
Safety / Compatibility: Never mix with any other cleaner. Test on a hidden seam first. Cushions must dry all the way through before they go back under a lid.

Primary Purpose: Float loose grit off outdoor furniture, decking, and pots before any cleaner is applied
Safety / Compatibility: Drain and disconnect before the first frost. Never run a hose across the walking route between the door and the steps.
